title: Interview transcript
description: The interview with one persona. The messages are the items of the artifact, each said by one of its participants.

participants.title: Participants

key.title: Key
key.description: The key that the messages of the participant name as their speaker: interviewer, or the key of the persona.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name shown beside the messages of the participant.

role.title: Role
role.description: What the participant does in the interview.

item_id.title: Item
item_id.description: The id of the item that the participant is, such as its persona; null for an agent.

participants.description: The people of the interview, the one who leads first. Set by the system.

turn_count.title: Turns
turn_count.description: Number of question and answer turns so far.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the interview is still running.

stop_reason.title: Stop reason
stop_reason.description: Why the interview ended. Null while it is in progress.

data_coverage.title: What was covered

data.title: What to find out
data.description: One item of the data that the plan asks the interviews to bring back.

covered.title: Covered
covered.description: Whether the interview brought that data back.

data_coverage.description: For each item of the data that the plan asks for, whether this interview brought it back.

top_findings.title: What stood out
top_findings.description: The three or four problems or wishes that the interview raised, in plain words.

follow_ups.title: Still to ask
follow_ups.description: Questions that the interview left open for a later round.
